name: Battery Management System and Modeling
description: Introduction to battery management systems (BMS) and their functionalities; fundamentals and working principles of lithium-ion batteries; battery modeling using equivalent-circuit and electrochemical approaches; electrochemical-thermal modeling of batteries; development and application of reduced-order models (ROMs); theoretical frameworks for state-of-charge (SOC) and state-of-health (SOH) estimation; and practical applications of state and health estimation techniques in BMS.
